record.question: Calculate SHP (Shaft Horse Power) requirement for clear water pump and capacity of Electric motor of the above pump for the following data: Rate of water supply = 55 Lpcd, Population (Design) = 6,000 souls, Total Static Head = 280 m, Total Head losses = 18 m, Combined efficiency = 70%, Pumping hour = 16 hours per day.
